brief.summary_1line: Rama sends Hanuman ahead to Ayodhya to inform Bharata of his return and gauge his reaction; Bharata, living ascetically, rejoices upon hearing the news.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman arrives at the hermitage and sees Bharata in bark garments and matted hair ruling before Rama’s sandals placed on a seat.
Overwhelmed with joy at Hanuman’s news, Bharata faints and then rises to embrace the monkey messenger with tears streaming down his face.
Hanuman speeds across rivers and forests toward Ayodhya like Garuda swooping upon a great serpent.
